description: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. is a leading natural resource-based building materials company, supplying aggregates, crushed stone, sand and gravel, through its network of approximately 400 quarries, mines and distribution yards in 28 states, Canada and The Bahamas, with aggregates generating 88 percent of the Company's total reportable segment gross profit in 2025. As of December 31, 2025 it also provides other building materials, namely cement, ready mixed concrete, asphalt and paving services in targeted markets where the Company has a notable aggregates position, and its heavy-side building materials are used in infrastructure, nonresidential and residential construction projects, while aggregates are also used in agricultural, utility and environmental applications and as railroad ballast, with the aggregates, cement, ready mixed concrete, asphalt and paving operations reported collectively as the Building Materials business.
